A **new user send** goes through export validation. An **internal upload retry** continues work on the existing send record and can replace the file Instead already holds.

| Path | Current behavior |
|---|---|
| New user send | Rejects an uploaded, non-archived document as `already_sent`, and a waiting/uploading document as `upload_in_progress`. Checks are scoped to the provider and return context. A failed upload is eligible to be sent again. |
| Internal retry | Can reuse the existing vendor file UUID and call `replace_doc_contents`; this replacement is part of recovery, not permission for a member to send an already uploaded file again. |

See [send validation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:78) and [upload selection](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/start_upload.rb:70).

The workflow’s preparation and reset path is:

1. **Resolve the Instead entity**, using an existing link, linking by name, or creating it. Then `start_uploads` loads the existing tax automation document IDs and calls `Instead::Documents::PrepareForSend` before scheduling uploads. [Workflow](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/export_async_workflow.rb:24)

2. **Authorize and reset in a transaction.** Preparation calls `resend!` where allowed, moving processing state—including `error` or `exceeded`—back to `sent`. It then calls `reset!` where allowed, moving upload state from `uploading`, `uploaded`, or `failed` to `waiting`. The transition hooks clear `failure_reason`; status broadcasts run after commit. This resets shared status without deleting the vendor file UUID. [Preparation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/prepare_for_send.rb:27), [state machines](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:42)

3. **Open → transfer → finalize.** Opening replaces contents when a UUID exists under the selected entity; otherwise it starts a new file. A replacement returning 404 clears the held UUID and raises `HeldFileLostError`, allowing the next attempt to open a new file. [Recovery](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/start_upload.rb:79)

There are two recovery levels to distinguish. **An individual Sidekiq step retry does not rerun workflow preparation**: for example, byte transfer tolerates a record already marked `uploading`. Its budget is 10 retries per run; throttling can reset that count, so this is not a fixed wall-clock bound. [Transfer](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/transfer_bytes_to_presigned_target.rb:27), [retry policy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:10)

Separately, reconnect recovery starts another export workflow for existing, non-deleted documents failed specifically with `unauthorized`; it does not resume every failed upload. That workflow reaches the preparation/reset path above. [ResumeSends](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/resume_sends.rb:33)
